methodology: DORA four keys + a DX Core 4-inspired Speed/Effectiveness/Quality/Impact breakdown, computed from public GitHub PR, Actions, and Issues data. Independent, unaffiliated reimplementation for portfolio/demo purposes.

impact.note: Proxy metric -- real Impact scoring needs planning-tool data (Jira/Linear), not just Git.

ai_impact.note: Positive delta = AI-flagged PRs took longer to merge; negative = faster. Detection is keyword/label-based and will miss undisclosed AI usage.

_note: This file ships with the repo so the dashboard has something to render out of the box. It's generated from the fixtures in tests/test_integration.py, not a live GitHub repo -- the sandbox this project was built in can't reach api.github.com. Run the CLI yourself (or let the scheduled GitHub Action do it) to get a real report for a repo of your choice.
